subject: Exploring Dedicated conversion credits, bridge months, and commit sizing
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda@fastapps.io>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring Dedicated: conversion credits & transition timeline

Diego,

Thanks for taking a look. We're evaluating a move from Redwood Hosted to a Dedicated pool for our core recommendation engine. A few things we need clarity on before we put this to procurement:

- Target sizing: estimate ~8x A100-equivalent GPUs for sustained peak inference (model: rwinstruct-v2, 16k context).
- Throughput SLO: ~100 inference requests/s (avg token output 120 tokens).
- Commit: looking at a 24-month reserved commitment but want an option to front-load if conversion credits make sense.
- Conversion credits / bridge months: we currently have ~$120k of remaining hosted spend credits and would like to understand how those convert to Dedicated commits (are they prorated? multiplier?). We also need a bridge period where we stay on hosted pricing while the Dedicated pool is ramping.

Can you share a concrete proposal (credits => commit offsets, suggested bridge months, example pricing for the 24-month commit, and any SLA/throughput guarantees)? Also include any caps or expiry on credits.

Thanks,
Amanda Liu
CTO, FastApps
---
Amanda Liu
FastApps, Inc.
www.fastapps.io

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@fastapps.io>
Date: 2026-07-12T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring Dedicated: conversion credits & transition timeline

Amanda — thanks for the clear ask. High-level proposal attached (proposal-draft.pdf) and summarized below. I want to be explicit about tradeoffs so procurement has concrete levers.

Summary (proposal):
- Sizing: 8x A100-equivalents baseline (we'll provide an autoscale buffer for burst up to 10x).
- Throughput guarantee: 100 req/s with 99th pct latency SLO at 250ms; credits apply if we miss the SLA more than 3 times in a rolling 30-day window.
- Commit term and usage credits: 24-month reserved commit. Conversion credit option: any remaining hosted prepaid credits can be converted to Dedicated "transition credits" at a 1.15x multiplier if the customer signs a Dedicated commit within 90 days of this proposal. The multiplier is intended to offset migration ops and initial inefficiency.
- Application of credits: credits are applied as dollar offsets against monthly Dedicated invoices until exhausted. If credits exceed first 6 months' invoices, remaining credits are amortized over the first 12 months of the commit.
- Bridge months: standard offer is 2 bridge months of hosted pricing at 50% of list (to smooth the lift). If you need 3 bridge months we can consider it as a commercial concession with a modest reduction to the conversion multiplier (e.g., 1.05x instead of 1.15x).
- Caps & expiry: conversion credit cap at $250k; credits must be converted within 90 days; bridge-month concession requires signed LOI within 30 days.

I've attached a draft that includes a worked example with your numbers and a rough estimate of monthly Dedicated billing under a 24-month commit. If you want a different ramp profile (e.g., ramp to 6x in month 1 and then full 8x by month 3) we can map that to commit offsets.

Attachments: proposal-draft.pdf (worked example), usage-snapshot.csv (please confirm this matches your telemetry).

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through details.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Liu <amanda@fastapps.io>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, procurement@fastapps.io
Date: 2026-07-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring Dedicated: conversion credits & transition timeline

Diego — appreciate the fast turnaround and the worked example. Two follow-ups from procurement:

1) Procurement asks if you can move to 3 bridge months (we expect the Dedicated pool provisioning + internal validation will take longer). If you agree to 3 bridge months, we want the conversion multiplier held at 1.10x (middle ground).
2) We also want price protection for the first 12 months of the commit (no increases per token or per GPU hourly list).
3) Please include SOC2 artifact references and a simple audit trail of data separation for inference jobs (our security team will request this later).

Can you update the offer and confirm whether the conversion credit cap can be increased to $300k with a commensurate minimum commit?

Thanks,
Amanda

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: FastApps - asks (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Amanda's note. High-level thoughts and a recommended commercial structure below. This is internal only — please don't forward externally yet.

Quick context: FastApps is mid-market SaaS, strong ML spend, wants 24-month commit, asking to push bridge to 3 months and increase conversion cap to $300k. They currently have ~$120k hosted credits.

Recommended commercial posture:
- Offer 3 bridge months at 50% hosted rate, but drop conversion multiplier from 1.15x to 1.10x (keeps econ neutral).
- Conversion credit cap: agree to $300k only if they commit to minimum $1.2M ARR-equivalent commit (24 mos). Otherwise cap at $200k.
- Apply credits first to the Dedicated invoice; amortize remainder over 12 months.
- Consider a one-time onboarding credit to cover migration engineering hours (e.g., $15k professional services credit).

Questions for finance (Karthik): can you model the amortization and recommended discount depth (we're targeting 18-22% gross margin on this deal after credits)? Also need to confirm whether we can agree to 12-month price protection.

Thanks — I'd like to close LOI by end of month.

— Diego

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: FastApps - asks (pricing model attached)

Diego / Marissa — attached is a quick pricing model (pricing-model.xlsx) with three scenarios: conservative ramp, our recommended ramp, and upside ramp. Notes: 

- Amortize converted credits over 12 months after initial application; show both immediate-apply and amortized lines.
- Cap increases: $300k OK if minimum committed value >= $1.2M (24 mo). If they stick with $1.2M we can still meet target margin ~20% after amortization.
- Bridge months: 3 months at 50% hosted is doable but reduces effective margin by ~2.5pts; still within range if conversion multiplier = 1.10x.
- Price protection: legal says we can commit to 12 months of price protection for token/GPU list, provided the contract includes an annual CPI clause (capped at 3%/yr) — happy to include that.

I'll flag the scenarios in the sheet. If you want, I'll pre-populate a simple LOI with the recommended structure.

— Karthik

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@fastapps.io>, procurement@fastapps.io
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Updated offer: FastApps Dedicated conversion & transition (LOI link)

Amanda — thanks for the patience. We've updated the offer based on procurement feedback and internal modeling. Summary of agreed commercial terms: 

- Baseline: 8x A100-equivalent Dedicated pool; autoscale to 10x for bursts.
- Commit: 24-month reserved commit; minimum committed value $1.2M.
- Conversion credits: convert hosted prepaid credits at 1.10x multiplier if LOI signed within 90 days.
- Conversion cap: up to $300k if min commit condition met; otherwise cap at $200k.
- Application: credits applied to Dedicated invoices until exhausted; any remainder amortized over first 12 months.
- Bridge months: 3 bridge months at 50% hosted rate.
- Price protection: 12 months guaranteed pricing, CPI clause capped at 3%/yr thereafter.
- Onboarding: $15k professional-services credit for migration support.
- SLA: 100 req/s throughput guarantee, 99th pct latency SLO 250ms; credits for SLA misses after 3 events in a rolling 30-day window.

Next steps:
1) LOI + commercial summary (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/sign/RndX-FAST-DED-042
2) Procurement to return signed LOI and PO (if applicable).
3) Redwood to schedule onboarding and capacity provisioning immediately after LOI execution.

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx (detailed amortization), proposal-draft.pdf (worked example). Also included SOC2 references and a short audit checklist link inside the LOI package for your security team.

If that looks good, I'll get legal to draft the formal SOW and contract and loop in our solutions engineer for a provisioning timeline.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposal-draft.pdf (worked example), pricing-model.xlsx (amortization scenarios)
